name: ui-tui
summary: The terminal dashboard for the apps OxidePM manages.
description: oxidepm monit opens a full-screen dashboard on your terminal: the apps with their state, CPU and memory, the details of the selected app, and its recent log lines. Stopping and restarting an app asks for y or n first. It can stop and restart apps (the lifecycle level), nothing else, and it runs only while the dashboard is open.
